name: UniversalMACrossEA
summary: A universal moving average crossover EA that generates trade signals when a fast moving average crosses a slow moving average. It supports multiple MA types (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA) and applies to any symbol and timeframe, with configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit. The EA opens buy positions on bullish crossovers and sell positions on bearish crossovers, optionally closing opposite positions on new signals.
summary_zh: 一个通用均线交叉EA，当快速均线穿越慢速均线时产生交易信号。支持多种均线类型（SMA、EMA、SMMA、LWMA），可应用于任意品种和周期，具备可配置的手数、止损和止盈。多头交叉时开多单，空头交叉时开空单，可选择在出新信号时平掉反向仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是经典的双均线交叉系统，利用快速均线与慢速均线的金叉和死叉作为趋势判断依据。入场条件为：当快速均线从下方向上穿越慢速均线时开多单（金叉），当快速均线从上方向下穿越慢速均线时开空单（死叉）。出场条件依赖止损和止盈参数的设置，同时提供反向信号平仓选项。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户资金动态调整仓位的机制。资金管理方面仅提供基本的止损止盈控制，缺少追踪止损、分批出场等高级风控手段。策略支持多种均线算法选择，增加了灵活性，但本质上仍是一个简单的趋势跟踪系统，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the classic dual moving average crossover system, using the golden cross and death cross of a fast and slow moving average as trend determination signals. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA (golden cross), and open a sell position when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA (death cross). Exit conditions depend on the configured stop loss and take profit parameters, with an optional feature to close opposite positions on new crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach without any dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management provides only basic stop loss and take profit controls, lacking advanced risk management features such as trailing stops, partial closes, or breakeven functionality. While the EA supports multiple MA algorithm types for added flexibility, it remains fundamentally a simple trend-following system that is prone to generating frequent false signals and consecutive losses during choppy, range-bound market conditions.

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和验证，适合初学者学习均线交叉系统
支持多种均线类型和价格类型，灵活性较高，可适配不同市场特征
通用性强，可应用于任意品种和周期，无需修改代码即可切换交易对象
提供反向信号平仓选项，可以在趋势反转时及时退出当前持仓
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and verify, suitable for beginners learning MA crossover systems
Supports multiple MA types and applied price types, offering high flexibility to adapt to different market characteristics
Highly universal — can be applied to any symbol and timeframe without code modification
Provides the close-on-opposite-signal option, enabling timely exit from current positions on trend reversal
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数无法根据账户风险和波动率自适应调整
没有追踪止损和保本功能，盈利头寸可能在回撤中回吐全部利润
止损和止盈默认值为0，即不设止损止盈，存在极大的资金风险
在震荡行情中均线交叉会产生大量虚假信号，导致频繁开平仓和连续亏损
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lots cannot adapt to account risk and market volatility
No trailing stop or breakeven functionality, meaning profitable positions may give back all gains during pullbacks
Stop loss and take profit default to 0, meaning no SL/TP is set, creating extreme capital risk
Generates numerous false crossover signals in ranging/choppy markets, leading to frequent open/close cycles and consecutive losses
Lacks a new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same candle
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，基于账户权益百分比或ATR波动率自动计算手数
添加追踪止损和保本功能，保护盈利头寸并优化出场策略
增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），避免在盘整阶段频繁交易
添加新K线检查和持仓检查逻辑，防止同根K线重复开仓和过度持仓
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR volatility for automatic lot calculation
Implement trailing stop and breakeven functionality to protect profits and optimize exit strategies
Add a ranging market filter (such as ADX or Bollinger Band width) to avoid frequent trading during consolidation phases
Add new bar check and position check logic to prevent duplicate entries on the same candle and over-exposure

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认值为0，如果用户未手动设置，交易将没有任何风险保护
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复触发信号导致过度交易
没有检查当前持仓数量，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓导致仓位过大
缺乏追踪止损机制，盈利头寸缺少保护，可能从盈利转为亏损
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0; if users do not manually set them, trades have no risk protection at all
No new bar check mechanism may cause repeated signal triggers on the same candle leading to over-trading
No check on current position count may cause duplicate same-direction entries leading to excessive exposure
Lack of trailing stop mechanism leaves profitable positions unprotected, potentially turning gains into losses
